historical_reviews.v3_1: DMTF Type 46 attaches one String Property ID and Value to a parent structure handle; multiple Type 46 structures can target the same parent, and ID ranges distinguish standard, BIOS-vendor and OEM meanings.

original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 46 String Property record, its ID/value semantics and exact parent-structure association against the owner-approved platform definition.
original_method: Preserve existing evidence, collect complete raw Type 46 and all referenced parent structures through protected read-only access, validate the fixed structure fields and ID namespace, decode only approved values, and compare the parent-bound property set without modifying firmware identity data.
manual_activity: The platform/security owner supplies the expected Property ID/value/parent-handle matrix, definitions for vendor/OEM IDs and redaction rules; an operator verifies target identity and protected access.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS identity
Expected Type 46 record count and handles
Expected Property ID, string value and Parent Handle matrix
Approved meaning for BIOS-vendor or OEM ID ranges
UEFI device-path comparison policy for standard ID 1
Sensitive-string classification, redaction and protected storage policy
safety_requirements: Do not modify BIOS, SMBIOS, asset or identity data
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL before preserving evidence
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Protect raw property values before redaction
Reject dangling, wrong-type or unexpected parent handles
Do not invent names for numeric IDs or decode reserved/vendor IDs without authority
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and approved Type 46 matrix
Collect complete Type 46 and referenced parent structures through protected access
Parse exact Property ID, Value and Parent Handle fields
Classify IDs by the standard/vendor/OEM ranges and decode only approved semantics
Resolve each parent handle and compare the parent-bound property multiset
Report malformed, duplicate, orphan or unexpected properties without mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve parent-bound property matrix and redaction policy
Resolve duplicate, reserved, absent or sensitive values
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 46 selector matches the source, but grep hides all property data and sshpass/disabled host checking weaken security and target identity; source log clearing is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through protected access collect unfiltered Type 46 plus referenced parents, retain raw ID/value/handle triples and validate ID namespace, value semantics and parent identity under the approved matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 46 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain; evidence-clearing boilerplate is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent each record as `(Property ID, raw String Value, Parent Handle)` and compare a multiset grouped by resolved parent structure; validate ID namespace before applying standard or approved vendor/OEM decoding.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact field, namespace and referential-integrity checks while correcting V2's generic name/value/encoding model.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A heading or decontextualized string cannot prove which property ID it represents or which SMBIOS structure owns it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor/OEM IDs are not interpretable from DMTF ranges alone, and raw strings may contain sensitive identity or endpoint data.

project_override_considerations: A Project can define vendor/OEM IDs and redaction, but must preserve raw protected evidence, numeric IDs and parent handles. Standard ID 1 is a UTF-8 UEFI device-path string produced by the specified conversion, not an arbitrary property name.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS identity, timestamp and approved Type 46 matrix
Protected complete raw Type 46 plus referenced parent output and exit status
ID-range classification and approved value decoding
Per-handle parent existence/type/identity and grouped-property comparison
Redaction/access/no-clear/no-mutation audit and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and selector consistently target SMBIOS Type 46 String Property. GPT V2's generic property model is corrected from the official schema without changing Master source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The comparison is deterministic once the owner supplies the parent-bound matrix, vendor/OEM meanings and sensitive-string policy.

review_improvement: Replaces a heading check with exact ID/value/parent referential validation and prevents guessed property names or unauthorized vendor/OEM decoding.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 46 string has no standalone meaning: its numeric ID selects semantics and its Parent Handle selects the structure it augments. Two identical values attached to different parents are different evidence, while a valid-looking value with a dangling parent is structurally invalid.
